about: The Sleep Calculator helps determine optimal bedtime and wake-up times based on sleep cycles. Quality sleep follows 90-minute cycles, and waking up at the end of a cycle helps you feel more refreshed and alert.
Understanding sleep cycles and timing can significantly improve sleep quality and daytime energy levels. The calculator considers natural circadian rhythms to optimize your sleep schedule.

faqs.question: How much sleep do I need?
faqs.answer: Adults typically need 7-9 hours, teenagers 8-10 hours, and children 9-11 hours. Individual needs may vary based on lifestyle and health factors.

faqs.question: What are sleep cycles?
faqs.answer: Sleep cycles are 90-minute periods consisting of light sleep, deep sleep, and REM sleep. Completing full cycles helps you wake up feeling refreshed.

faqs.question: Why do I feel groggy when I wake up?
faqs.answer: Waking up in the middle of a deep sleep phase can cause grogginess. Try adjusting your bedtime to complete full 90-minute cycles.

faqs.question: Should I keep the same sleep schedule on weekends?
faqs.answer: Yes, maintaining consistent sleep and wake times, even on weekends, helps regulate your circadian rhythm and improves overall sleep quality.
